content.text: The stats API caps a query at 7 days plus 1 hour, so I'll pull the final totals in two windows and add them.

Fernwick's Black Friday trial campaign ran Nov 21–28 (Eastern) and has ended. The campaign and line item are now paused. Total spend was **$484.27 of the $500 budget**.

**Week recap**

| Metric | Total |
|---|---|
| Spend | $484.27 |
| Impressions | 487,218 |
| Link clicks | 294 |

Cost per link click was about $1.65.

**By post**

| Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| "Crashes in your Unity, Unreal or Godot build?" (2123280103634283814) | $68.50 | 111,071 | 42 |
| "one SDK for Unity, Unreal and Godot..." (2123461297568149236) | $243.20 | 177,201 | **147** |
| "The 60-day trial ends Cyber Monday..." (2123642491501123261) | $151.66 | 120,085 | 92 |
| "$0 for 60 days..." (2123823685432753560) | $20.92 | 78,861 | 13 |

The "one SDK for Unity, Unreal and Godot" post did the most work, with the most clicks and about half the spend. The "$0 for 60 days" post was the weakest by click-through rate and got the least spend. Everything ran as one ad group, so the spend split came from X's delivery, not from manual allocation.

**Things to know**

- **Sign-ups aren't measured.** We have no X pixel on the site, so I can't report sign-ups, free plan or trial starts from X. The only conversion-side number is the 294 link clicks. If you want sign-ups tracked for future campaigns, you'd need to add a pixel or tag. I didn't create one here since you hadn't asked for it.
- **Copy and dates don't line up.** Two of the posts say the offer runs through Nov 30, but the ads stopped Nov 28 per your brief. That's fine if it's intended, but people who see the posts on Nov 29–30 won't see paid reach.
- **Targeting:** US and Canada only, as you asked. I didn't add an age or interest filter because the interest search returned nothing for "video games."
- **Budget:** I set a $62.50 daily budget with a $500 total cap. Spend was steady around $60 a day. About $15.73 went unspent.

Account details: account `184hxd2iszy`, campaign `qsnrq`, line item `bxj0m`.
